attempts.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (both immediate and boot-persistent) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (install usb-storage /bin/false + blacklist usb-storage) and regenerated the initramfs with dracut -f --omit-drivers usb-storage to ensure it can't be pulled in early boot either. Verified the module cannot be loaded, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until it came back, confirmed a changed boot_id, and re-verified system health and that the blacklist still blocks loading after reboot.
